reason.description: CORE-2. Present on a 401 `permission_denied` for a credential the host refused, and nowhere else: which refusal it is, because each has a different next step. `credential_expired` - one approval away from working again (re-pair); `credential_revoked` / `device_purged` - taken back on purpose on the computer; `unknown_credential` - not a credential this host signed (another installation, or a damaged token).

detail.description: Bounded, code-specific context. Only the codes remote-api.md documents carry one; every value is a string, an integer or a boolean.
